query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_vendas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN saleType = 'BALCAO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as balcao_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN saleType = 'DELIVERY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as delivery_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN saleType = 'A_PRAZO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as prazo_count,
  SUM(finalAmount) as total_valor,
  SUM(CASE WHEN saleType = 'BALCAO' THEN finalAmount ELSE 0 END) as balcao_valor,
  SUM(CASE WHEN saleType = 'DELIVERY' THEN finalAmount ELSE 0 END) as delivery_valor,
  SUM(CASE WHEN saleType = 'A_PRAZO' THEN finalAmount ELSE 0 END) as prazo_valor
FROM sales 
WHERE YEAR(createdAt) = 2025 AND MONTH(createdAt) = 12;
